name: Telegram
notes: web.telegram.org/a/ is the older, lighter web client (formerly webogram); the default web.telegram.org/k/ is a heavier React build that is a much worse bet for a CLoop/baseline-JIT armv7 engine.
The scheme is telegramweb, not telegram: the real Telegram app registers telegram:// and a collision would break LaunchServices resolution for both, same reasoning as Instagram's instagramweb.
